## Setup

```{r packages + settings}
library(tidyverse)
library(socsci)
library(geomtextpath)
library(coolorrr)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggridges)
library(here)
library(countrycode)
library(patchwork)
set_palette(
  qualitative = c(
    "steelblue",
    "orange",
    "navy",
    "red",
    "green3"
  ),
  binary = c("navy", "orange"),
  sequential = c("white", "navy"),
  diverging = c("steelblue", "gray", "red3")
)
source(here::here("_helpers", "splot.R"))
theme_set(my_theme())
saveit <- function(num = 1, ht = 5, wd = 7) {
  ggsave(
    here::here(
      "117_war_trends_comparison",
      paste0("fig", num, ".png")
    ),
    height = ht,
    width = wd,
    dpi = 500
  )
}
```

## Data

```{r}
library(peacesciencer)
source("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/milesdwilliams15/Teaching/refs/heads/main/DPR%20101/Data/_peacesciencer_extras_for_101.R")
# source loads:
# add_icd_mics() --- works like add_cow_mids()
# add_opportunity() --- adds prd and opportunity
# tercile() --- cuts a continuous var into terciles with labels
create_dyadyears(
  directed = F,
  subset_years = 1816:2014
) |>
  add_cow_mids() |>
  add_icd_mics() |>
  add_opportunity() |>
  select(
    # keep identifiers and time
    ccode1:year,
    # keep relevant COW conflict measures
    cowmidonset, cowmidongoing, hostlev,
    # keep relevant ICD conflict measures
    icdmiconset, icdmicongoing, icdmichostlev,
    # keep measures of relevance
    prd, opportunity
) -> dt
```

## Figures

```{r}
#| fig-height: 5
#| fig-width: 7

dt |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarize(
    "Total MID Onsets b/t Country Pairs" = sum(cowmidonset),
    "Total MIC Onsets b/t Country Pairs" = sum(icdmiconset)
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(2:3) |>
  ggplot() +
  aes(year, value, color = name) +
  geom_line(
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  ggpal("binary") +
  labs(
    title = "MID and MIC datasets don't perfectly align",
    subtitle = "Count of country pairs on opposite sides of new conflict onsets",
    captiopn = logo,
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    color = NULL
  )
saveit(1)
```


```{r}
#| fig-height: 5
#| fig-width: 7

dt |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarize(
    "MIDs per Dyads" = mean(cowmidonset),
    "MIDs per PRDs"= mean(cowmidonset[prd == 1]),
    "MIDs per Opportunities" = sum(cowmidonset) / sum(opportunity),
    "MICs per Dyads" = mean(icdmiconset),
    "MICs per PRDs" = mean(icdmiconset[prd == 1]),
    "MICs per Opportunities" = sum(icdmiconset) / sum(opportunity)
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(-year) |>
  ggplot() +
  aes(year, value) +
  geom_line(
    color = "gray"
  ) +
  stat_smooth(
    data = . %>%
      filter(year < 1939 | year > 1945),
    aes(group = year > 1945),
    method = "lm",
    formula = y ~ 1,
    color = "red3",
    fontface = "bold.italic",
    level = .84
  ) +
  geom_textvline(
    xintercept = (1939 + 1945) / 2,
    label = "WWII",
    color = "steelblue",
    hjust = 0.8,
    linewidth = 4,
    fontface = "bold",
    vjust = 2,
    alpha = .4
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ name, ncol = 3, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "The denominator still matters more",
    subtitle = "Rate of country pairs on opposite sides of new conflict onsets",
    captiopn = logo,
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::percent
  )
saveit(2)
```
